description: This file defines the ToDoPresenter class for a GWT-based ToDo application, managing task lifecycle, UI updates, routing, and local storage persistence.

classes.name: ToDoPresenter
classes.description: Main class managing the ToDo application's presentation logic, including task management, routing, and persistence.

classes.name: ToDoPresenter.View
classes.description: Interface for the view component, defining methods for UI interactions and updates.

classes.name: ToDoPresenter.ViewEventHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling user events from the view.

methods.name: parseRoutingToken
methods.description: Converts routing string tokens into ToDoRouting enum values.

methods.name: updateFilteredList
methods.description: Updates the list of tasks displayed based on current routing.

methods.name: updateTaskStatistics
methods.description: Calculates and updates task count and completion statistics in the view.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Removes a specified task from the list and updates the UI.

methods.name: itemStateChanged
methods.description: Handles updates when a task's state changes, including removal if title is empty.

methods.name: taskStateChanged
methods.description: Updates filtered list, statistics, and saves state after task changes.

methods.name: markAllCompleted
methods.description: Sets all tasks to completed or not completed.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Creates a new task from user input and adds it to the list.

methods.name: clearCompletedTasks
methods.description: Removes all completed tasks from the list.

methods.name: saveState
methods.description: Serializes current tasks to local storage.

methods.name: loadState
methods.description: Loads tasks from local storage into the application.
